mapper.sql: select q.question_id, q.user_id, q.user_name, q.user_avatar, q.crop, q.title, q.content, q.images, q.view_count, q.like_count, q.reply_count, q.status, q.create_time, q.ai_result, q.ai_status, (select u.region from sys_user u where u.user_id = q.user_id) as region, (select a.expert_avatar from smx_expert_answer a where a.question_id = q.question_id and a.del_flag = '0' order by a.answer_id limit 1) as avatar, (select concat_ws(' ', a.expert_name, a.expert_title) from smx_expert_answer a where a.question_id = q.question_id and a.del_flag = '0' order by a.answer_id limit 1) as expert, (select a.content from smx_expert_answer a where a.question_id = q.question_id and a.del_flag = '0' order by a.answer_id limit 1) as answer from smx_expert_question q
mapper.select: select q.question_id, q.crop, q.title, q.view_count, q.reply_count, date_format(q.create_time, '%m-%d') as date, a.answer_id, a.content as my_answer, a.images as my_answer_images, date_format(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as my_answer_date from smx_expert_question q join smx_expert_answer a on a.question_id = q.question_id and a.del_flag = '0' where a.answer_user_id = #{userId} and q.del_flag = '0' order by a.answer_id desc
select images from smx_expert_question where del_flag = '0' and question_id = #{questionId}
select count(1) from smx_expert_question where del_flag = '0' and question_id = #{questionId}
select user_id from smx_expert_question where del_flag = '0' and question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.insert: insert into smx_expert_question (user_id, user_name, user_avatar, crop, title, content, images, ai_status) values (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{userAvatar}, #{crop}, #{title}, #{content}, #{images}, #{aiStatus})
mapper.update: update smx_expert_question set view_count = view_count + 1 where question_id = #{questionId}
update smx_expert_question set like_count = greatest(0, like_count + #{delta}) where question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.select: select like_count from smx_expert_question where question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.update: update smx_expert_question set reply_count = reply_count + 1, status = '1', update_time = sysdate() where question_id = #{questionId}
update smx_expert_question set reply_count = greatest(0, reply_count - 1), update_time = sysdate() where question_id = #{questionId}
update smx_expert_question set status = if(exists(select 1 from smx_expert_answer where question_id = #{questionId}), '1', '0'), update_time = sysdate() where question_id = #{questionId}
update smx_expert_question set ai_result = #{aiResult}, ai_status = #{aiStatus} where question_id = #{questionId}
